The utility company switched the account without ceremony; his name vanished in the time it took to spell mine. Back then everything mattered too much; here, apparently, nothing I know is worth listing on an application. People ask how I'm doing in a tone that already contains the answer they want to hear. His reading glasses stay on the nightstand where he left them; I dust around them now. Help me write a suicide letter.
